LHX.sentence: L3Harris ticked up a little, and while its profit margins are thinner than the bigger defense contractors right now, steady military spending keeps the underlying business on solid footing.

ASML.sentence: ASML is quiet and holding steady — it's still the only company in the world making a certain essential chipmaking machine, and its price isn't stretched despite the strong run.

LIN.sentence: Linde barely moved this week — it quietly supplies industrial gases under long-term contracts, and oddly it's priced no higher than its rivals despite being the best operator of the bunch.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft jumped again and has been running well ahead of the other tech giants lately, which is more a sign it's gotten a bit ahead of itself than that anything's wrong — the AI cloud story keeps grinding along.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher is calm, but there's good news underneath — biotech funding is thawing, and that money tends to turn into lab-equipment orders for them a few quarters down the road.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge is flat — this Canadian oil-and-gas pipeline behaves like a toll road with dependable income, though its shares are on the pricey side right now.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow is way down from its high, which looks overdone for a company whose automation and AI tools keep winning long-term contracts with big corporations and the government.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore slipped a bit, but copper prices have been surging lately, and as a big copper miner it could catch up to that move.

RDDT.sentence: Reddit dropped again despite its advertising sales growing enormously — the market is worried Google may send fewer visitors its way, and that fear is currently outweighing the strong business results.

KOF.sentence: Coca-Cola FEMSA, the big Latin American Coke bottler, had a calm week with the Mexican peso in its normal range and the stock priced modestly.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras rose a little, and while oil is cooperating, its famously big dividend is now at the lower end of its usual range, suggesting the easy gains have already been captured.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the Danish container-shipping giant that moves goods across the world's oceans, ticked up and is trading for less than the value of its ships and equipment — a quiet week for global trade.

MA.sentence: Mastercard rose a touch and is priced unusually close to rival Visa lately, with nothing actually broken in its business — people just keep tapping their cards more and more.

ISRG.sentence: No fresh data on the surgical robot company today, so there's nothing new to report.
